verdict.rationale: Automated follow-up on overdue invoices is a fair question for a business finance platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents dunning, payment reminders, or automatic chasing of overdue receivables. The Bills API covers payables (invoices received from vendors), and webhooks are only developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can have overdue invoices automatically followed up on without manual chasing
